reason: I never pay for creator tools, so Pro at ₹199 is a no even if it's cheap. I might try the free scam check on one of those sketchy DMs, but I'm not handing over 5% of a deal I could have negotiated myself or with my manager.
objection: Brands already come to my DMs and I already know my rates. Why give an AI 5% of my deal or let it send payment reminders from my account? And a small beta team doesn't feel safe with my Instagram login.
would_change_my_mind: If the free version caught a real scam or got me a noticeably higher rate on a real deal, I'd think about the 5% option. I still wouldn't pay up front.
